pattern_1.transformation: Parse 'Collection Date' (campaign date, one per plot). No time-of-day reported; localize the date to the field timezone America/Denver and convert to UTC. Four 'RMBL - RM' rows have a corrupted 'Collection Date' cell (spreadsheet '####' overflow) that coerce to NaT; their measurements are retained.
Depth not reported as a column; populate from package metadata 'measurementTechnique' (TDR 20-cm probe length). Approximated depth; flagged qc_flag = 'd1'.
pattern_1.unit_conversion: Divide by 1e2 to convert from cm (20) to m (0.20).
